mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 20 trading days signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days, reflecting weak labor market conditions and reduced growth prospects.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day forward returns occur despite UNRATE crossing above 5.0% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (demand) crosses above 11,000 and INDPRO (supply) crosses below 100, the overexpansion of demand relative to supply contraction signals economic overheating, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 11000 and INDPRO crosses below 100
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns occur when GDPC1 and INDPRO exhibit the specified interaction, or the combination does not lead to contractionary effects.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation surge in CPIAUCSL above 200 triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days, as investors anticipate higher interest rates and reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 200 in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO over 60 days indicates strengthening supply chains and production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns persist despite a sustained upward trend in INDPRO over the prediction horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS (payrolls) rises above 134,000 and UNRATE falls below 5.0%, the tight labor market signals wage inflation and reduced business investment, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 134000 and UNRATE crosses below 5.0%
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur when PAYEMS and UNRATE exhibit the specified interaction, or the combination does not result in negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high HOUST (demand) and low RSAFS (demand) indicate peak demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate an economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: within late-cycle expansion regime, HOUST crosses above 2100 and RSAFS crosses below 350000
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in the late-cycle expansion regime when HOUST and RSAFS show the specified interaction, or the regime conditions do not align with the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 95 signals supply contraction, reducing production capacity and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns occur despite INDPRO crossing below 95 in the trigger period.
